title: Landstede Hammers Pull Away After the Break to Capture the DBL Crown
description: Landstede Hammers are champions of the Netherlands once again, overpowering Zorg en Zekerheid Leiden 90-74 at a raucous Landstede Sportcentrum to wrap up the Dutch Basketball League title. For a half, Leiden hung tough. The visitors actually edged the second quarter to keep things close, trailing by just two at the interval after a high-scoring opening in which both sides shot better than 50 percent inside. But the Hammers seized control after the break, winning the third quarter 20-14 and then blowing the game open with a dominant 24-13 final period to turn a tight contest into a comfortable 16-point triumph.
